## Verified Minecraft 1.21.4 mapped build

`ChainVeinFabric-4.1.0+1.21.4.jar` — Fabric / Java 21.

Validation includes production survival clients, genuine Quick Shulker v3/v4 and vanilla/Fabric TCP clients, standalone/direct/legacy server cases, two released bedrock miners, and a dedicated-server 15% bidirectional-loss case. The Servux hand-confirmation case requires zero wrong server blocks and no persistent direct-API busy state. The 800-tick workload uses at most 160 drain ticks; complete random-loss convergence is not required.

Printer ports preserve upstream 1.1.3 placement behavior. Source: [2854847](https://github.com/water2004/ChainVeinFabric/tree/2854847e730ad9c9446d9b6d621636c9c94776d3). [Pinned CI](https://github.com/water2004/ChainVeinFabric/actions/runs/39728232003).
